name: Visit Rwanda
verdict: Paid for by a government that UN experts say has 3,000–4,000 troops fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo.

why.text: Rwanda’s government pays to put its tourism brand on the shirt. UN experts say 3,000–4,000 Rwandan troops are fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo, and estimate that the rebels make about $800,000 a month from the coltan trade there. A famous shirt makes Rwanda look like a holiday destination while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: UN experts say 3,000–4,000 Rwandan troops are fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo.
